# CURRICULUM_REVIEW — 部编版一年级识字表 (700 characters)

**Generated by `lune run scripts/compile-curriculum` — do not edit; correct the raw JSONs instead.**

This file exists for the owner's spot-check against the physical textbook before the
store-page claim ("all 700 Grade 1 characters") ships. The compilation is model-knowledge
anchored to the web game's 236 poster characters; the sections below surface the least
certain entries first. To correct anything: edit `data-src/raw/shangce_300.json` /
`xiace_400.json` (move, add, remove, or re-spell entries), rerun the compile script, then
`lune run scripts/build-data`. No code changes are ever needed for content fixes.

| confidence | count | meaning |
|---|---|---|

| low | 13 | best-effort fill — CHECK THESE FIRST |

**Known caveat:** the kickoff spec assumed the 236 poster chars were a subset of the 上册 300.
They are not quite: 17 of them (夜柳菜读内先名班级件 卫 etc.) belong to 下册 lessons
(e.g. 姓氏歌, 文具的家, 夜色). The enforced invariant is: all 236 poster chars ∈ the 700 total. ✓
